projects.name: Iowa DOT Five Year Program Projects (public view)
projects.notes: 2027-2031 Iowa Transportation Improvement Program (Program = '2027-2031 Program'); all records are programmed future work, one row per project/year/work type (Year2 = 2027..2031; SummaryWorkType and SummaryYears roll up the project). 'Right of Way' is its own Work_Type. AmountTotal looks like thousands of dollars (sample 2306) - check before use. No status field. Table 1 in the same service is the report table.

parcels_statewide.name: Iowa Statewide Parcel Data, 2017 (University of Iowa mirror of the Iowa HSEMD layer)
parcels_statewide.notes: STALE: snapshot dated 2017-11-02 (layer name Parcels_20171102). Deed holder name only: no mailing address, site address, value or acres; text fields are space-padded. STATEPARID is county number + parcel number; PARCELCLAS is the class (e.g. AGRICULTURAL). No current free statewide layer with owners was found, so use county layers for current ownership.

parcels_counties.notes: Linn County's own ArcGIS Online layer, assessment year 2026; OwnerContract holds contract buyers.
Scott County Cadastral service; also deed-holder address fields (DeedAddr1-3) and contract holders (ContrHold).
Copyright 'Black Hawk County'. Total value is the sum of landval + bldgval + dwlgval.

parcels_counties_note: Not found or not reachable in the time allowed: Polk (gis.polkcountyiowa.gov did not resolve; only third-party extracts found), Johnson (gis.johnsoncountyiowa.gov answered 403).
summary: Projects: Iowa DOT Five Year Program 2027-2031 lines verified (work type, year, amount). Parcels: the only statewide owner layer is a 2017 snapshot with deed holder name only; current owner layers verified for Linn, Scott and Black Hawk counties, Polk and Johnson not reachable.
